scope: Semantic recheck of 9 Tata, 4 Tatabánya and 32 Eger original municipal-source features. Read-only recommendation; no source geometry, registry, review decision or catalog changed.
policy: A municipal plan can expressly define real named quarters. Planning purpose alone does not disqualify the quarter.
Name identity, geometry extent, source-era boundary schema, fine-quarter hierarchy and source reuse rights are independent claims.
A combined group polygon must not be duplicated under its component names. A partial plan polygon must not be relabeled as a complete quarter.
Functional quarters may be valid if municipality explicitly defines them. Industrial, forest, lake or outside-built-up character is not itself a reason to reject.
Retain all geometric-validator exclusions, georegistration uncertainty, source dates, source reuse uncertainty and non-address-assignment status.

summary.finding: The blanket false identity override demonstrably loses authentic named quarters in Tata/Tatabánya and authentic quarter names in Eger. Tata/Tatabánya map titles explicitly establish a quarter-boundary schema. Eger is mixed: 24 named statutory-quarter footprints are potential source-defined candidates with schema qualification; eight must remain groups / partial areas / nonquarter plan coverage. None is established as a current ITS quarter boundary.

tata2022.title: TATA VÁROS SZABÁLYOZÁSI TERVE - VÁROSRÉSZEK LEHATÁROLÁSA - M=1:50.000
tata2022.inspection: Original local PDF text and rendered page visually inspected. Nine selected named colored areas plus unselected surrounding Külterületek; no numeric regulatory-sector names.

tataIts.title: Tata város Integrált Településfejlesztési Stratégiája – Megalapozó vizsgálat
tataIts.inspection: Official-domain indexed excerpt only; full PDF exceeds web-reader size limit. Figure 9 is named Tata városrészei. Text explicitly explains industrial park recognized as separate quarter due its different characteristics and size. Corroborates names and intended urban hierarchy, not exact identity with 2022 geometry.

tataItvt.title: Tata Integrált Települési Vízgazdálkodási Terve
tataItvt.inspection: Official-domain indexed excerpt only. Településrészek legend includes the same nine names, plus Zártkertek and Külterület. Öreg-tó described as an area characterized by the large lake and nearby forests; not merely an isolated water-feature name.

tatabanya2018.title: TATABÁNYA VÁROSRÉSZEK TELEPÜLÉSRENDEZÉSI SZEMPONTÚ LEHATÁROLÁSA
tatabanya2018.inspection: Original local PDF text and rendered page visually inspected. Explicit named city-quarter map with 16 visible named areas, not a list of numbered building zones. Four currently extracted source areas are only a subset.

tatabanyaLaw.title: Tatabánya MJV Helyi Építési Szabályzata, 8/2018. (IV.19.)
tatabanyaLaw.inspection: Official law text opened. 1.§(2) explicitly identifies annex 3 as city-quarter delimitation for town-planning purposes. Retrieved version header is 2023.01.03.; original local map is annex to 2018 law. No independent basis found for describing the PDF itself as 2024.

tatabanyaSikvolgy.title: Tatabánya közszolgáltatási rendelete, 41/2013. (XII.2.)
tatabanyaSikvolgy.inspection: Official-law indexed excerpt calls Síkvölgy and Szőlőhegy city quarters outside a planning-map context. This corroborates name category, not geometric accuracy.

eger2016.title: SZABÁLYOZÁSI TERVEK LEHATÁROLÁSA – 2. számú melléklet – ÁTNÉZETI TÉRKÉP
eger2016.inspection: Original local PDF text and rendered page visually inspected. Legend distinguishes 2016 unified HÉSZ, separate 2014 Északkeleti külterület és Bikalegelő regulation, older retained planning maps, and general 2004 TSZT. Accordingly, this is not one homogeneous city-quarter partition.

egerHesz.title: Eger MJV Helyi Építési Szabályzatáról szóló 4/2016.(II.26.) rendelet – egységes szerkezet
egerHesz.inspection: Official PDF opened. Cover explicitly calls named areas city quarters; chapter V has quarter-specific provisions, including Hajdúhegy-észak. Annex 2 described as overview of HÉSZ/SZT affected areas. Source-defined regulatory quarter names are genuine; that does not establish identity with the 21 ITS quarter footprints.

eger2023.title: Eger MJV TFT Megalapozó Vizsgálat
eger2023.inspection: Official-domain indexed excerpt only; full PDF exceeds web-reader size limit. States 21 distinctive quarters and explicitly warns their extents frequently do not coincide with HÉSZ regulatory delimitations. Figure 107 refers to ITS 2014–2020 quarters. This is a schema warning, not evidence that all HÉSZ names are fictitious.

egerPlanIndex.title: Szabályozási tervek – Eger hivatalos önkormányzati oldala
egerPlanIndex.inspection: Official page opened; confirms mixed whole-quarter maps and modifications of small partial areas. Index identifies Almár részterület_2008 and OMYA Kőbánya Iparterülete_1998.

egerGalagonya.title: Eger településrendezési terveinek rendeletszám-jegyzéke
egerGalagonya.inspection: Official-domain indexed excerpt identifies the Galagonyás-dűlő source plan as the cellar area adjoining Szabadidőpark, a part of the quarter. Cannot represent the entire named quarter.

egerDobo.title: Eger MJV településrendezési eszközök módosítása – Belváros, Szent Miklós és Hajdúhegy városrész kapcsán
egerDobo.inspection: Official-domain indexed excerpt distinguishes Dobó tér és környéke regulatory plan. Original 2016 map labels the small polygon Belváros / Dobó tér; not a complete independent Belváros quarter.

implementationAdvice: For Tata/Tatabánya, replace blanket false identity/kind override only through a separately reviewed integration, preserving source-specific statutory delimitation label. Source IDs should remain stable.

For Eger, avoid a blanket true/false override. Authentic quarter names deserve true name-identity even if geometry remains planning_unit. A schema-aware layer may admit 24 named source-defined quarter candidates, but it must explicitly retain 2016 statutory scope and keep its count separate from fully verified ordinary-quarter boundaries.
Grouped Eger units can be useful parent footprints. Do not interpret them as evidence that component boundaries have been collected.
The 2016 Eger overview has changed or old regulatory-map boundaries; do not combine it silently with 21 ITS quarters or use it for automatic address assignment.
Current source-era and modern quarter names were corroborated through official sources, not through Google Maps. No Google-derived geometry or license assertion introduced.
